decisions.reason: Substantive Socket/BleepingComputer follow-up on the May Mini Shai-Hulud campaign: actions-cool/issues-helper and actions-cool/maintain-one-comment were re-enabled on Sept 16 with release tags still pointing at the May 18 malicious commit, so workflows resumed pulling the payload through Sept 25. Direct continuation of the existing worm story.

decisions.story_title: Trojanized ad-tech script swapped visitors' crypto wallet addresses in real time
decisions.reason: Distinct real web-based attack: a trojanized ad-tech script performing live crypto wallet address swapping, with a published analysis and IOCs. No existing story covers it and it is not commentary on a story already in the store.
One-line aggregator repost of a blogspot link about Wireshark 4.6.9; no CVEs, versions, or release detail in the content. Thin repost, not primary reporting.
Content-farm SEO explainer (usanews24 blogspot) posing a headline question about AI agent regulation; no concrete incident, CVE, or advisory.
Auto-mirrored CVE database page for CVE-2026-71418; single sentence, no vendor advisory, no patch or exploitation evidence. Below the coverage bar for a lean store.
Theoretical research headline about cracking textbook (unpadded) RSA, which is not the RSA deployed in practice; tech-press coverage with no operational security impact.
Rapid7 weekly Metasploit module roundup; vendor blog digest with an empty body in the feed. No standalone event worth covering.
